scenarios.title: Steps, spikes and dropouts on negatives: Break vs neutralised climb

wells.note: +32 at 10 min on a quiet trace: repaired as an offset, NOT a Break (repair runs first, no upper size)
RPL01004 s2: +19.3 at 5 min, sigma 0.8 -> repaired, not P
-30 at 10 min: invisible to checkJump, repaired
+25 in the last 6 readings -> tail hold
+32 on sigma 3: 2.5x < jump < 4x local range -> Break
+40 on sigma 4.5: dodges the climb gate (4x range) AND checkJump (post-step slope > 1.0) -> the scorer reads the smoothed edge as a rise
why: documented: current algorithm answers P, intent is B
